component.name: Buzón
component.summary: The email client of the Nodalia suite

description.p: Buzón is the email client of the Nodalia suite: a native desktop app, written in Rust with GTK 4. Your mail and credentials stay on your machine, remote content is blocked until you allow it, and there is no telemetry. It works with IMAP, POP3, JMAP and Microsoft 365, and with any server from iCloud to Proton Bridge to a Stalwart of your own.

ul.li: Multiple accounts with a unified Inboxes view; Google, Microsoft and custom OAuth sign-in, or an account imported from GNOME Online Accounts
Whole-mailbox sync and search, conversation threading, and changes made on other devices synced back
Folder management, filters, tags, unified and filtered folders, and Trash and Junk emptied by hand or on a schedule
An attachment gallery, an Outbox for sends that fail, and Send Later
Rich text, Markdown, HTML or plain text, with HTML signatures, inline images, spell check and undo
Drafts, quote folding, split replies, and forwarding that keeps the attachments
Large files uploaded to your own Nextcloud, OneDrive, Dropbox or Seafile; a Send with Buzón entry in GNOME Files
Reader View, your own font and colors, and per-message light or dark rendering
OpenPGP signing, encryption and reading; DKIM, SPF and DMARC checked on arrival
Meeting invitations answered in place, and one-click unsubscribe from list mail
Adaptive three-pane layout, five appearance themes, Focus Mode, a customizable toolbar and swipe actions
Gmail-style single-key shortcuts, notifications with actions, an optional tray icon and background running
GNOME Contacts integration, your choice of language and clock, and passwords kept in the system keyring
